scope: Own eight-object schematic pilot, not textbook mastery or M33 closure
training_sources: Visually curated participant drawings; Quick, Draw!, CC BY 4.0. Source-category proposals were not admitted blindly. No external pretrained weights.

attempts.evaluation: Known object regression set, not a new blind exam. Fresh procedural legacy retention sets. Seven inspected textbook diagnostics are not training or selection inputs.

independent_check: Pure-Python replay of selector, metrics and gates on 4371 saved prediction records per attempt. Not independent semantic annotation or a general honesty proof.
limits: Zero errors with zero object answers is not mastery. Definitions, properties, photos, the full textbook corpus and unrestricted dialogue are not learned in this pilot.
next_step: Improve visual-feature learning while preserving legacy skills. Do not relax safety thresholds to manufacture acceptance. A fresh independent final cohort is required before a new acceptance claim.
